document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Day by day, the specter of starvation shadows your trek. You 
fail to find sufficient food and are wracked with hunger spasms 
and become weakened and lethargic. As you trudge along the 
shores of the North Hanninah, no game in sight, you suddenly 
feel a psychic change.

Something  presses  down  upon  you,  something  oppressive 
and stifling. It forces you to your knees in the pebbly sand. Is 
this real or some creation of your imagination?

This attack has a POW of 80. Make an opposed roll with your own 
POW. If you win, go to 120. If you lose, go to 162.
